CommunityApplications.Profile:
NovaCortex is self-hosted, MCP-native long-term memory for AI agents — typed memories (episodic, semantic, procedural, working), semantic vector search, a relation graph and a knowledge base, all running on your own hardware. Agents talk to it over MCP (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code), REST, the CLI or the TypeScript/Python SDKs.
This repository ships the Unraid distribution of NovaCortex, installable two ways — both end up with the same five containers:
- **Community Apps templates:** `novacortex-redis`, `novacortex-surrealdb`, `novacortex-qdrant`, `novacortex-api` and `novacortex-web`. Install them in that order on a shared `novacortex` Docker network (`docker network create novacortex`). Appdata paths, host ports and passwords are all normal template fields, so nothing needs editing by hand. The three backing-service templates pin the same upstream images the Compose stack uses. - **Docker Compose Manager:** `docker-compose.unraid.yml` brings the whole stack up in one click. An optional `local-ai` profile adds an Ollama sidecar so embeddings and memory intelligence run fully offline — no memory text ever leaves the server.
Everything is Apache-2.0 and the free tier needs no license key or account. Images are published to GHCR at `ghcr.io/nova-cognitive-systems/novacortex-{api,web}`.
Support: https://github.com/Nova-Cognitive-Systems/novacortex/issues
